# HAPI v0.30.7.1 (maintained build)

Upstream-first rebuild from official GitHub Release `v0.30.7` at `0239edf38e2da653d662f31039e24ccea04c7837` with audited open PRs.

## Compared with the previous maintained release

Compared with `v0.30.4.1`:

- Rebase onto official `v0.30.7`. Inherit official improvements from `v0.30.4` through `v0.30.7` without replaying already-upstreamed work.
- Restores and integrates `#1436` (voice dictation direct-send and cross-session message delivery), fixing the regression where the voice direct-send button disappeared when PR #1436 was deferred in `v0.30.4.1`.
- Keep the maintained source overlay, including `#1771` native `hapi-session-runtime`, project labels (`#1635`), single-machine label omission (`#1414`), filter-time group collapse (`#1797`), PWA icons (`#1625`), unified sync labels (`#1617`), and single-line fork/rewind confirm copy (`#1603`).
- Retain the fork PID-reuse lock from `swear01/hapi#19`.
- Maintain Hub upgrade offer and CLI artifact routes (`/api/upgrade`, `/cli/upgrade`).

## Compared with the official release

Compared with official `v0.30.7`, includes the maintained desktop, fleet upgrades, imports, model-error handling, scratchlist, schema V29, protocol V2 overlay, session-roots guard, voice dictation direct-send, and the audited changes above.

## Personal PR policy exceptions

`#1436` is carried as personal author auto-carry, restoring the voice direct-send button and cross-session delivery. `#1771` is kept as the native session-runtime skill. `#1635` and `#1419` are carried.

## Distribution

Standalone four-part maintenance release, with signed macOS CLI archives, Linux and Windows CLI archives, Windows/macOS desktop bundles, and `checksums.txt`. Optional platform packages remain on official `0.30.7`. The implicit standalone upgrade channel remains off.
